from pocket_coffea.lib.processor import BaseProcessor
from pocket_coffea.lib.columns_manager import ColOut
import awkward as ak


class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    def process_object_preselection(self, df, dataset):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = df.Muon
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        df["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]
        return df

    def process_object_counting(self, df, dataset):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        df["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(df.MuonGood)
        return df
